summary: Both Round 2 findings fixed red-first; VM gate green, assigned corpus categories clean, and unrelated failures unchanged.
body:
Accepted both findings; rejected none. All earlier fixes remain intact.

Files changed:

- [export.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs:1108): embedding requires frame-aligned endpoints and forward 1× playback; audioMix emits `preservePitch="false"`.
- [export/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs:949): five new regressions/control tests.
- [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs): earlier assigned exemptions remain removed; unchanged this round.

Embedding previously accepted matching clocks that the renderer cannot reproduce accurately. The exporter now checks both endpoints using exact Tick/rational arithmetic. Subframe, reversed, or speed-adjusted pairs retain one independent audioMix placement, picture `hasAudio="false"`, and a linkage-loss warning. The [XSD](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:6319) defaults pitch preservation to true; explicitly disabling it preserves FilmCraft’s varispeed behavior.

Renderer issue for the coordinator:

- [sr-deliver/src/audio.rs:422](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-deliver/src/audio.rs:422) samples layer clocks at frame boundaries. [sr-audio/src/mix.rs:476](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-audio/src/mix.rs:476) skips audio without a current-frame source time. At 24 fps, a layer starting at 0.01s begins audio around 0.041667s; `[0.01,0.02)` becomes silent.
- [sr-audio/src/mix.rs:479](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-audio/src/mix.rs:479) extrapolates forward at 1× when the next frame has no clock. For reversed source `[5,6)` over one second at 24 fps, the final frame should descend from approximately 5.041667 toward 5.0; it instead advances toward 5.083333. For 2× source `[5,7)`, it advances from 6.916667 toward 6.958333 instead of 7.0. Conservative exporter fallback remains necessary until this renderer behavior changes.

No importer changes, dependencies, or borrowed code. Renderer files above were consulted only. The earlier audio deduplication, transition fallback, duplicate-ID rejection, animation guard, and separate bounded traversal budget remain.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn export(project: &Project, sequence: ItemId, format: Format, opts: &ExportOptions) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)>
pub(crate) fn export(p: &Project, seq_id: ItemId, opts: &ExportOptions, report: &mut Report) -> Result<String>
```

VM TDD log—all test names below use prefix `scene_export_review_`:

| Test | Observed red → green |
|---|---|
| `subframe_linked_audio_uses_mix` | 0 placements, expected 1 → passes for either off-grid endpoint and a between-frame clip |
| `reversed_linked_audio_uses_mix` | 0 placements, expected 1 → passes |
| `varispeed_linked_audio_uses_mix` | 0 placements, expected 1 → passes at 0.5× and 2× |
| `independent_varispeed_disables_pitch_preservation` | Missing `preservePitch` attribute → explicit false, passes |
| `rational_frame_grid_keeps_linked_audio` | Positive control passed before and after |

Earlier red→green evidence remains recorded: linked-audio clip count 2→3 corrected; 10,000 siblings produced 0 exports instead of 2, now passes. Round 1 transition, duplicate-ID, and animation regressions also pass.

Final VM gate: formatting and clippy `-D warnings` passed; **329 tests passed, 0 failed, 6 unrelated ignores**; wasm passed for **51 crates**. All **51 export tests** passed.

Pinned corpus: **1,343 cases, 1,676 exports/schema checks, 3,352 successful re-imports**. Round 2 failure records: **183 → 183**, with identical case/mode/stage/diagnostic identities.

| Category | Before → after this round |
|---|---:|
| linked-audio | 0 → 0 |
| 10000-siblings | 0 → 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 → 11 |
| external-expression | 122 → 122 |
| material-override | 6 → 6 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 → 18 |
| voxel-palette | 14 → 14 |
| generated-id | 12 → 12 |

The full corpus command exits 101 solely for unchanged unrelated failures. [Verification and adjacent raw logs](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/fixexport/round2-verification.json) contain the evidence.

Task completed; locks released. Changes remain uncommitted.
